<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 360" width="500" height="360">
  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Magnetic Field Region (shaded/dotted area with boundary) -->
  <rect x="150" y="80" width="220" height="200" fill="#f4f4f4" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="6,4" />

  <!-- Magnetic Field Crosses (×) -->
  <g fill="#000000" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="14">
    <!-- Row 1 -->
    <text x="180" y="115" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="220" y="115" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="260" y="115" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="300" y="115" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="115" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    
    <!-- Row 2 -->
    <text x="180" y="155" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="220" y="155" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="260" y="155" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="300" y="155" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="155" text-anchor="middle">×</text>

    <!-- Row 3 -->
    <text x="180" y="195" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="220" y="195" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="260" y="195" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="300" y="195" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="195" text-anchor="middle">×</text>

    <!-- Row 4 -->
    <text x="180" y="235" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="220" y="235" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="260" y="235" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="300" y="235" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="235" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    
    <!-- Row 5 -->
    <text x="180" y="270" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="220" y="270" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="260" y="270" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="300" y="270" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
    <text x="340" y="270" text-anchor="middle">×</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Magnetic field label 'B' (directed into page) at top right of field -->
  <text x="340" y="100" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16">B</text>
  <text x="348" y="104" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="12">(into page)</text>

  <!-- Electron Path (Semicircle) -->
  <!-- Enters at (150, 240) moving right, curves up and around, leaves at (150, 120) moving left -->
  <path d="M 90 240 L 150 240 A 60 60 0 0 1 150 120 L 90 120" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2" />

  <!-- Velocity vectors / arrows on path -->
  <!-- Entering vector -->
  <line x1="110" y1="240" x2="135" y2="240" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="135,240 127,236 127,244" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="120" y="258" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16">v</text>

  <!-- Leaving vector -->
  <line x1="135" y1="120" x2="110" y2="120" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <polygon points="110,120 118,116 118,124" fill="#000000" />

  <!-- Center of semicircle -->
  <circle cx="150" cy="180" r="3" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="158" y="184" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16">C</text>

  <!-- Radius indicator -->
  <line x1="150" y1="180" x2="210" y2="180" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />
  <text x="175" y="172" font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-style="italic" font-size="16">r</text>

  <!-- Electron label -->
  <circle cx="150" cy="240" r="4" fill="#000000" />
  <text x="145" y="262" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14">electron</text>

  <!-- Fig caption -->
  <text x="250" y="325" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14">Fig. 3.1</text>
</svg>
